adventure_defines.restrictions_text: Raistlin starts in the formation. He can be moved, but not removed. Only Raistlin and Champions not next to him can deal damage. After area 100, attacks against undamaged enemies have a 90% chance to completely miss. 1-2 Baaz Draconians spawn with each wave. They don't drop gold nor count towards quest progress. Getting to Know Raistlin: Raistlin's role is dealing damage, and he deals more damage when he is next to fewer Champions. Place him in an isolated spot of a formation to increase his damage!

adventure_defines.name: Test of Sorcery
adventure_defines.description: Search for some missing ships during Fleetswake in Waterdeep with Champions that buff specific formation slots!
adventure_defines.restrictions_text: Raistlin starts in the formation. He can be moved, but not removed. Fizban joins the formation. Champions in Fizban's column deal 1000% additional damage. This bonus counts as a positional formation ability. You may only use Champions that have positional formation abilities. In each boss area, a Sivak Draconian boss spawns as part of the first wave. It must also be defeated to progress. Getting to Know Raistlin: Raistlin's damage is increased dramatically when he is buffed by positional formation abilities that target 4 or fewer Champions in the formation. This buff further increases as the number of Champions buffed by the ability is reduced!

adventure_defines.name: War of the Lance
adventure_defines.description: Search for some missing ships during Fleetswake in Waterdeep with some stalwart heroes!
adventure_defines.restrictions_text: Raistlin starts in the formation. He can be moved, but not removed. You may only use Good Champions, Tanking Champions, or Champions with a ranged or melee attack. Champions do not regain health when changing areas. Every 3 seconds, a random Champion is struck by a falling rock, dealing 5% of their maximum health in damage. 1-2 Kapak Draconians spawn with each wave. They don't drop gold nor count towards quest progress. In each boss area, an Aurak Draconian boss spawns as part of the first wave. It must also be defeated to progress. Getting to Know Raistlin: Raistlin's specialization choice determines which Champions he works best with. Which Champions will you add to the formation?

Gale starts in the formation. He can't be moved or removed.
Only Gale and Champions buffed by Gale's Archmage's Insight can deal damage.

adventure_defines.name: Pawn to Cleric Four
adventure_defines.description: Defend Triboar while being assisted by a limited number of allies.
adventure_defines.restrictions_text:
Gale starts in the formation. He can be moved, but not removed.
You may only use Champions with an Intelligence of 13 or higher, Heroes of Baldur's Gate affiliation members, and/or Absolute Adversaries affiliation members.
Getting to know Gale: Gale's second specialization choice determines which heroes are best to solve the problem at hand.

adventure_defines.restrictions_text:
Gale starts in the formation. He can be moved, but not removed.
Elminster joins the formation. He distracts adjacent Champions with his stories, increasing their normal attack cooldowns by 3 seconds.
You may only use the base 12 Core Champions and/or Champions that have been released in the last 3 years.
Getting to know Gale: Gale is always available for any of his Mentor's patron challenges, even if the restrictions would say otherwise. Gale's buffs further increase as you complete Elminster Patron variants!

adventure_defines.name: Volo's Guide to Diversity
adventure_defines.description: Search for some missing ships during Fleetswake in Waterdeep while facing a menagerie of monsters.
adventure_defines.restrictions_text:
Volo starts in the formation. He can be moved, but not removed.
Elminster joins the formation. Champions next to Elminster deal no damage as he distracts them by critiquing Volo.
1-2 random enemies spawn with each wave. They don't drop gold, nor count towards quest progress. The type of enemy is determined by the area you're in, with the type changing every 10 areas.
Getting to know Volo: Volo's buff gets stronger the more enemy types you encounter in an adventure. Pair him with certain Hunter Champions to spawn more enemy types.

adventure_defines.restrictions_text:

1-2 Relentless Undead spawn with each wave. When defeated, they get back up after 5 seconds. They don't drop gold, nor count towards quest progress. 
You may only use Hunter Champions, Absolute Adversaries affiliation members, and/or Champions with a Magic base attack.
Getting to know Volo: Volo's first specialization choice determines which Champions he works best with. Which set will you choose?

adventure_defines.description: Search for some missing ships during Fleetswake in Waterdeep with Sheila's absolutely trustworthy friend, Karena!
adventure_defines.restrictions_text:
Sheila starts in the formation. She can be moved, but not removed.
Karena joins the formation. Good Champions next to Karena deal no damage.
You may only use Champions that have an age of 20 or younger, a total ability score of 78 or lower, or Female and/or non-binary Champions.
Getting to know Sheila: Sheila's first specialization choice further refines which allies she works best with. Make sure you still use a Good aligned DPS to make the most of her buff!

adventure_defines.name: Venger the Destroyer
adventure_defines.description: Search for some missing ships while fighting enemies that need to be debuffed to be damaged.
adventure_defines.restrictions_text:
Sheila starts in the formation. She can be moved, but not removed.
At the start of each Boss area, Venger arrives on his nightmare as an additional boss that must be defeated.
Starting in area 51, enemies that don't have an active debuff reduce all normal attack damage to just 1 point of damage.
Getting to know Sheila: Sheila's second specialization choice lets you pick a different way to debuff your enemies. Use her and other debuffing Champions to defeat these enemies!

Getting to Know Kyre: Kyre can stun enemies and increase damage against them. Use them and other Champions that stun to get through these foes!

adventure_defines.description: Discover the fate of some merchants in the jungles of Chult with some of Kyre's favorite associates.
adventure_defines.restrictions_text: Kyre starts in the formation. They can be moved, but not removed. You may only use Good Champions, Control Champions, or Champions with a Dexterity of 16 or higher. After area 50, bosses spawn with a segmented special shield with 5 hits which must be destroyed before their regular hit points appear. To destroy a special shield segment, an enemy must be hit with a critical hit. 1-2 Shadows spawn with each wave. They don't drop gold nor count towards quest progress. Getting to Know Kyre: Kyre's specialization choice determines which Champions they work best with. Who will you add to the formation?

adventure_defines.name: Kobolds in Trench Coats!
adventure_defines.description: Discover the fate of some merchants in the jungles of Chult with Zrang up top!
adventure_defines.requirements_text: Must have completed "The Missing Merchants (Hew Maan)"
adventure_defines.restrictions_text: Hew Maan starts in the front row of the formation. They can't be moved or removed. Two of Hew Maan's "Human" friends have also joined the formation to see them in action! Quest requirements are doubled in non-boss areas Getting to know Zrang - Because of their location in the formation, Zrang is on top of Hew Maan, meaning that enemies have a 25% chance to count double for quest progress (Teamwork). Kleeb and Yassa are not on top, which means that hits-based and armor-based enemies and blockers have a 50% chance of spawning with 25% of their hits already gone, and the base attack cooldown of Champions adjacent to Hew Maan are reduced by .5 seconds (Please Stand By)!

adventure_defines.name: More Dead Than Hew Maan
adventure_defines.description: Discover the fate of some merchants in the jungles of Chult with Kleeb at the helm!
adventure_defines.requirements_text: Must have completed "The Missing Merchants (Hew Maan)"
adventure_defines.restrictions_text: Hew Maan starts in one of the middle rows of the formation (slot 5). They can't be moved or removed. Relentless Undead monsters spawn and attack your formation. When they are killed, they don't disappear. Instead, after 5 seconds, they get back up and resume their relentless attack. Getting to know Kleeb - Because of their location in the formation, Kleeb is on top of Hew Maan, meaning that Champion damage against bosses is increased and if that boss has hits-based or armor-based health, successful attacks destroy twice as many segments as they normally would (Teamwork). Yassa and Zrang are not on top, which means that boss enemies move 25% slower, and the base attack cooldown of Champions adjacent to Hew Maan are reduced by .5 seconds (Please Stand By)!

adventure_defines.name: Hit 'em fast, Hit 'em hard

adventure_defines.requirements_text: Must have completed "The Missing Merchants (Hew Maan)"
adventure_defines.restrictions_text: Hew Maan starts in the back row of the formation. They can't be moved or removed. Armored abyssal chickens spawn in each area. These chickens drop no gold, nor do they count towards quest progress. Every 10 areas an additional Armored Abyssal Chicken spawns and attacks. Getting to know Yassa - Because of their location in the formation, Yassa is on top of Hew Maan, meaning that Champion damage is increased in the two columns in front of Hew Maan (Teamwork). Kleeb and Zrang are not on top, which means that hits-based and armor-based enemies and blockers have a 50% chance of spawning with 25% of their hits already gone, and bosses move 25% slower (Please Stand By)!

adventure_defines.description: Discover the fate of some merchants in the jungles of Chult with the help of a Cockatrice.
adventure_defines.restrictions_text:
Vi starts in the formation. She can be moved to other slots, but she can't be removed from the formation.
Vi's Arcane Cannon ultimate starts out unlocked.
All Champion Base Attack cooldown speeds are increased by 8 seconds.
If you activate Vi's second use of her Arcane Cannon ultimate in the last 5 seconds of the ultimate's duration, it's cooldown is immediately reset.
Getting to know Vi: Vi's ultimate has a second stage that you might lose if you forget to activate it. Learn how to get the most out of it!

adventure_defines.name: Time For a Good Hug
adventure_defines.description: Discover the fate of some merchants in the jungles of Chult with everyone playing their part.

You can only use Neutral on good/evil axis and Evil Champions that have the DPS role, and you can only use Good Champions that have the Support role.
Getting to know Vi: Vi likes formations where you surround a neutral Champion with good ones. Figure out how to use it to your advantage!

adventure_defines.restrictions_text:
Two Explorers join the formation. They deal no damage and can't be moved.
Good Champions deal no damage with their base attacks.
All non-boss area quest requirements are doubled, twice as many monsters spawn with each wave, and monsters drop half the amount of gold.

quest_defines.description: While out for a stroll on the Triboar Trail, you've come across a smashed wagon by the road being harassed by satyrs.
More satyrs appear. Recover some of the villager's lost supplies.
More satyrs interrupt your conversation with the villager. How rude!
Collect some of the satyrs' simple weapons to sell in the village the next time you're there.
The leader of the satyrs has shown himself at last. Take him out to end the attack.
Ivor's directions to the hunter's camp have taken you a few miles north, into the Neverwinter Wood.
All of this battling has left you quite peckish. Collect some berries from the side of the path.
You've stumbled across a wolf pack with some newly born cubs. Fend off the angry parents and their pups.
There's something peculiar about this particular pack. They seem to be driven to attack out of fear rather than anger.
Defeat the wolves' fearsome leader.
Clean up what's left of the worg's twisted wolf pack before parting ways with Randal Amberwood.
The temple is a few miles further into the woods, where the trees are so thick that sunlight becomes fleeting.
Collect fly wings to construct a crude scare-fly to keep any more flies away.
Another pack of wolves! You can't imagine a baker's daughter would survive long in these woods.
An angry boar blocks your path. There's only one way forward.
You begin to spot signs of the temple: moss-covered pillars, shattered stone paving stones.
Even the ruins are infested with wildlife. This temple hasn't been inhabited in ages.
Try to make sense of the animal tracks. Investigate some more carefully.
Defeat the crazed wildlife and stealthily make your way closer to the vine-covered temple entrance.
As you search the ruins, a strange creature jumps out of the shadows and attacks!
Make your way carefully into the main temple ruins.
The halls are damp and slick with algae. Search for any signs of habitation within the ruins.
These creatures seem to be more intelligent than your normal forest fare.
You spot small torn pieces of colorful cloth on the ground. Could they be from Ivor's kidnapped daughter?
You round a corner and there's Ivor's daughter, Kara! Rescue her from the fearsome beast looming over her!
You need to figure out where in the temple the library is. See if any of the local beasts are carrying a map.
With the aid of the map you quickly reach the library. It's a mess. Re-sort one of the shelves.
Search for books or scrolls regarding lycanthropy or curses.
The creatures here seem agitated that you're poking around so much.
Without warning, the librarian attacks! He must have finally picked up on your lack of lycanthropic curse.
You head towards the chamber the lycanthropes are using as a kitchen.
The kitchen is infested with rats, and not surprisingly, wererats. This has got to be some sort of health code violation.
All this searching has left you quite peckish. While you're here you may as well make a stew.
You're going to need some meat for your stew. Steal it from the wererats.
The wererat leader doesn't want to share. Show him the door.
Make your way through the temple to the barracks. They seem to be slightly more kept than the rest of the temple.
The wereboars seem to have taken over the barracks area. They're extremely aggressive.
Grab some scrap metal. You'll need it to repair your gear after all the fighting.
Search for the wereboar leader. He may know who's in charge around here.
Through a door bursts the wereboar leader. Convince him to sit still for an interrogation.
Search for a key to the priest quarters on your way there.
The werebears fight with an animal rage and ferocity to keep you away from the inner sanctum.
Many of the werebears appear to be clutching holy symbols. Perhaps a clue?
You're finally starting to thin them out. Fight harder!
The werebear leader is here, and he doesn't seem pleased.
You burst through the door into the high priest's chamber and are immediately set upon by wolves.
Only a few of the tapestries in this room haven't been shredded by the feral wolves.
Another wave of werewolves attacks!
A group of werewolves appears from the door near the back. Maybe the leader is back there!
The werewolf leader finally joins the fight. Take him down!

sequence.text: Thank you for your help, friend. My name is Ivor Bakovski.
sequence.name: Villager

sequence.text: Do ye need a hand gettin' yer things back to town, Ivor?
Don't worry about our things, you've got to find my daughter, Kara! She's been taken!
sequence.name: Ivor

sequence.text: Did you see what direction the Satyrs took your daughter?
No, it wasn't them. It was a terrible Beast!
sequence.name: Ivor

sequence.text: I don't know what it was. Huge. Hairy. A terrible roar. A hunter came into our village the other day talking of strange beasts in the woods. People have been disappearing for months. Maybe the hunter can help you track down the beast.
sequence.name: Ivor

sequence.text: Help! The pack has my camp surrounded!
sequence.name: Hunter

sequence.text: Stand firm, hunter. We'll deal with them.
The name's Randal Amberwood. I assume you're here about the beasts. I've tracked them to an abandoned temple nearby.
sequence.name: Hunter

sequence.text: We're lookin' for Ivor Bakovski's daughter, Kara? Did you see her? Is she safe?
I'm not sure. I couldn't get close enough to the temple, but I can tell you where it is.
sequence.name: Randal

sequence.text: Ugh, flies. I hate flies.
Look! Temple ruins. We must be getting close. Stay alert!
There be all sorts of tracks here. Wolves, bears, boars, and even some smaller tracks I don't recognize. There's something not quite right about all this.
The animals here seem more like guards than wild creatures. What's going on?
A Wererat! Out here, in the woods? They're usually found hidden away in cities or towns. Keep your eyes peeled for any of his brothers or sisters.
Moradin's beard! These ruins seem to be suspiciously well kept. The beast who took the villager's daughter must be lurkin' within.
Wait! No! It's not what you think!
sequence.name: Kara

sequence.text: Don't worry, you're safe now.
Safe? You just attacked my fiance! You're the real beast here!
sequence.name: Kara

sequence.text: My name is Pavel Nonov. My companions and I were infected with the curse of lycanthropy against our will. We fight it every day. Some of us, anyway.
sequence.name: Dashing Werewolf

sequence.text: By Moradin, that's terrible. Isn't there somethin' we can do to help ye?
Your cleric. She can cast a spell to remove this curse.
sequence.name: Pavel

sequence.text: You're right, but Selûne willing, I'll need a scroll of Remove Curse to do so.
The temple has a Library. Perhaps you can look there.
sequence.name: Pavel

sequence.text: Is there a particular book you're looking for?
sequence.name: Weretiger Librarian

sequence.text: Do ye have any scrolls of Remove Curse?
Curse? This is a blessing.
sequence.name: Weretiger Librarian

sequence.text: Agree to disagree, then?
Not all the Lycanthropes here seem to share Pavel's view on their curse. We'll need to be careful.
We need to find a scroll of Remove Curse if we're going to have any chance of freeing him.
Let's look around and see if we can find out who's in charge here.
Nobody comes between me and my stew.
These creatures are too far gone to be cured, but I may still be able to do something for Pavel. If only we can find a scroll.
Then let's keep looking.
Who's in charge around here? Who leads yer group?
The wolves lead us. They are in the priest's chambers, but you'll have to get through the bears to get at them. You'll never make it.
sequence.name: Wereboar Leader

sequence.text: Ye underestimate our resolve, cursed one.
This must be the right direction. These creatures would not fight so hard if we were chasin' our own tails.
Bruenor, these are the symbol of Beshaba, the goddess of misfortune. They may have some hand in this madness.
If our information is correct, the wolves are in the High Priest's Chamber. Let's get this over with.
Aha! He was carrying some scrolls. Hoarding them so that nobody could turn away from him. Just give me a moment..
I just want to be with my dearest.
sequence.name: Pavel

sequence.text: Selûne, grant me strength. [casts Remove Curse]
It... It worked! I can't believe it! Thank you, heroes!
sequence.name: Pavel

sequence.text: Now we can finally be together! Thank you!
sequence.name: Kara

event_v2_defines.name: Fleetswake
event_v2_defines.description: This Waterdeep centric festival celebrates the sea, sea trade, and the gods of the sea. It involves boat races, the Shipwright's Ball at the Shipwright's House, and guild-sponsored galas at the Copper Cup festhall. Fleetswake culminates in the Fair Seas Festival. It is a ceremony dedicated to placate the goddess Umberlee, during which tithes are given to her by dropping coins (including those collected during Fleetswake by increasing the normal docking fee to 1 gp), into the deepest reaches of the harbor. Strong currents drag this wealth into Umberlee's Cache.

upgrade_defines.name: Hoardsperson
upgrade_defines.tip_text: K'thriss collects extra coins from defeated enemies and uses them to empower a Shadow Demon that he summons when he uses his Ultimate Ability.

upgrade_defines.name: Velvet Touch
upgrade_defines.specialization_description: K'thriss contacts his unseen servant Velvet to increase the damage of Champions that are far from him in the formation.

upgrade_defines.name: Ligotti's Minions
upgrade_defines.specialization_description: K'thriss's familiar Ligotti empowers the formation's damage and gold find abilities based on the number of Champions that are part of his favorite Acquisitions Incorporated affiliations.

upgrade_defines.name: The Unknowable Ur
upgrade_defines.specialization_description: K'thriss's Patron Ur provides a big increase to his buffs, decreasing as enemies are defeated in the current area.

upgrade_defines.name: Mischievous, but Dangerous
upgrade_defines.tip_text: Fen increases the damage of Champions in her column.

upgrade_defines.name: Patron's Oath
upgrade_defines.tip_text: Fen increases the amount of progress credited in Patron Challenges in the party she is in.

upgrade_defines.name: Shadows of the Underdark
upgrade_defines.specialization_description: Fen focuses on her eldritch blade, increasing her support and dealing additional damage.

upgrade_defines.name: Curse of the Dhampir
upgrade_defines.specialization_description: Fen focuses on her Dhampir heritage, dealing much more damage.

upgrade_defines.name: The Fury of Avernus
upgrade_defines.tip_text: Karlach increases the damage of all Champions in her column and the column behind her.

upgrade_defines.name: Rage
upgrade_defines.tip_text: Karlach further increases the effect of The Fury of Avernus each time she attacks or is attacked in an area.

upgrade_defines.name: Wild Magic
upgrade_defines.specialization_description: Karlach embraces the mental connection she has with other Champions undergoing Ceremorphosis, increasing her support capabilities.

upgrade_defines.name: Wildheart
upgrade_defines.specialization_description: Karlach's unrelenting ferocity while raging sustains her, healing some of the damage she's taken each second.

upgrade_defines.name: Berserker
upgrade_defines.specialization_description: Karlach's rage is filled with unmatched fury, increasing her damage.

upgrade_defines.name: Unorthodox Alliance
upgrade_defines.tip_text: Kalix buffs Champions not next to him, and these buffs increase based on the number of Champions that are not a Standard species.

upgrade_defines.name: Strength in Numbers
upgrade_defines.specialization_description: Kalix aligns himself with one well represented species, making his telepathic bond with his allies even stronger.

upgrade_defines.name: Creative Camouflage
upgrade_defines.specialization_description: Kalix improves his camouflage skills, making him a more dangerous threat when he is frequently attacked.

upgrade_defines.name: One For You, One For Me
upgrade_defines.specialization_name: One For You, One For Me
upgrade_defines.specialization_description: Kalix concentrates on his hunting abilities, quickly tracking down his favored foes and making them more vulnerable to damage.

loot_defines.name: Simple Staff
loot_defines.description: My brother and I planned a secret journey.

loot_defines.name: Apprentice Staff
loot_defines.description: I had been selected to take the Test. You can imagine my pride.

loot_defines.name: Staff of Magius
loot_defines.description: We traveled to the secret place, the Towers of High Sorcery.

loot_defines.name: Staff of Magius Alight
loot_defines.description: There I passed the test. And there I nearly died!

loot_defines.name: Discarded Book
loot_defines.description: While you and my brother played with wooden swords, I spent my time in study.

loot_defines.name: Theobald's Academy Textbook
loot_defines.description: During the Cataclysm, the city of Xak Tsaroth was cast down the side of a cliff.

loot_defines.name: Raistlin's Spellbook
loot_defines.description: My brother, there is something you must bring me from the dragon's lair.

loot_defines.name: Spellbooks of Fistandantilus
loot_defines.description: It is one of the mage's early books. One he had when he was very young indeed.

loot_defines.name: Common Robes
loot_defines.description: When I awoke, my skin had turned this color - a mark of my suffering.

loot_defines.name: White Robes of Solinari
loot_defines.description: My body and health are irretrievably shattered. And my eyes!

loot_defines.name: Red Robes of Lunitari
loot_defines.description: I see through hourglass pupils. I see time, as it affects all things.

loot_defines.name: Black Robes of Nuitari
loot_defines.description: I see you dying, slowly, by inches. And so I see every living thing.

loot_defines.name: Withered Herbs
loot_defines.description: I must replenish the herbs that heal my cough.

loot_defines.name: Medicinal Herbs
loot_defines.description: My body was my sacrifice for my magic. This damage is permanent.

loot_defines.name: Raistlin's Tea
loot_defines.description: I am much better. Leave me to my concoction.

loot_defines.name: Mysterious Reagents
loot_defines.description: My spell components are secret.

loot_defines.name: Unidentified Stone
loot_defines.description: You have never heard of him, yet he was one of the greatest of my order.

effects.description: Increases the effect of Raistlin's Specializations by $(amount)%.

loot_defines.name: Fake Bloodstone
loot_defines.description: His name was Fistandantilus. Ask me no more! You are as bad as the others!

effects.description: Increases the effect of Raistlin's Specializations by $(amount)%.

loot_defines.name: Bloodstone of Fistandantilus
loot_defines.description: It is valuable to me. I must have it! I must!

effects.description: Increases the effect of Raistlin's Specializations by $(amount)%.

loot_defines.name: Dragon Orb of Istar
loot_defines.description: None of us will come out of Silvanesti unscathed, if we come out at all.

effects.description: Increases the effect of Raistlin's Specializations by $(amount)%.

loot_defines.name: Powdered Herbs
loot_defines.description: Pound this in a cup and add water, then stir and drink. Ignore the smell.

loot_defines.name: Flashpowder
loot_defines.description: The halcyon days I spent in mimicry of a simple illusionist are long gone.

loot_defines.name: Dagger of Magius
loot_defines.description: Don't do it, my brother. Come no closer.

loot_defines.name: Spellbook of Magius
loot_defines.description: Par-Salian told me the day would come when my strength would shape the world!

loot_defines.name: Kobold Lute
loot_defines.description: Deekin great kobold hero, but still just little kobold.

loot_defines.name: Cracked Lute
loot_defines.description: Ooo! You wants to hear Deekin sing! Deekin gladly sing for hero!

loot_defines.name: Deekin's Lute of Amazingness
loot_defines.description: The suspense builds! The music swells!

loot_defines.name: Magical Doomlute of Doom
loot_defines.description: He forgets how it goes, but nobody knows, 'cause Deekin's singing a so-ooong!!

loot_defines.name: Looted Crossbow
loot_defines.description: Is you talking to Deekin? You not the boss, so Deekin not gots to talk to you.

loot_defines.name: Crossbow of Doom
loot_defines.description: Has Deekin told you recently about doom?

loot_defines.name: Bloodstained Crossbow
loot_defines.description: Is hard to write epic story when blood be everywhere.

loot_defines.name: Reverberating Crossbow
loot_defines.description: Doom doom DOOM! Doomity doom doom DOOM! You like?

loot_defines.name: Moldy Parchment
loot_defines.description: Ummm... Deekin not feels so good.

loot_defines.name: Quill & Torn Parchment
loot_defines.description: Maybe Deekin pencil you in as sidekick?

loot_defines.name: Epic Tale of Doom
loot_defines.description: Deekin busy writing great, epic tale, so he not gots time to talk to you.

loot_defines.name: Bound Masterpiece
loot_defines.description: Lots of epic story gets cut out. But not the doom. No. Never the Doom. . .

loot_defines.name: Tymofarrar's Present
loot_defines.description: Heh... Deekin just thinkings to that one time you yells at Deekin. Ahhh, good times...

loot_defines.name: Dinged Bracers
loot_defines.description: Stop Deekin if you've heard this one: There once was a man from the Moonsea. . .

loot_defines.name: Shiny Bracers
loot_defines.description: Deekin might have shiny bracers, but Deekin still gots bad back.

loot_defines.name: Bracers of the Epic Adventure
loot_defines.description: And suddenly, boss came upon the lair of their enemy! Huzzah!

loot_defines.name: Bag of Bashed Clamshells
loot_defines.description: Deekin feel like bag of clamshells bashed on ground repeatedly. Overall is good.

loot_defines.name: Clamshell Soup Ingredients
loot_defines.description: The boss and Deekin, faithful kobold companion, continue their voyage.

loot_defines.name: Stinky Bag of Clamshells
loot_defines.description: The boss pretends not to notice that Deekin recently passed gas.

loot_defines.name: Deekin's Treasures
loot_defines.description: Ummm... is 'backpack' be one word or two?

loot_defines.name: Potato Sack Armor
loot_defines.description: Deekin hurts pretty bad. Is adventuring always likes this?

loot_defines.name: Stained Leather Armor
loot_defines.description: Deekin gots complete confidence in you. Deekin knows that you is great hero, you is!

loot_defines.name: Boss' Vest
loot_defines.description: Deekin pretends not to notice that the boss' clothes have not been washed recently.

loot_defines.name: Monster Hunter Vest
loot_defines.description: We be in the dungeon with monsters! Ooooh yeah!

loot_defines.name: Rusty Crossbow
loot_defines.description: A little tougher to reload than your average crossbow.

loot_defines.name: Oak Crossbow
loot_defines.description: A sturdy crossbow, though its destructive potential is lackluster.

loot_defines.name: Reinforced Crossbow
loot_defines.description: Reinforced with an alloy of my own invention.

loot_defines.name: Thunderbolt
loot_defines.description: The draw strength is several times higher than any gnome could manage unaided.

loot_defines.name: Worn Cloak
loot_defines.description: Well worn and still warm, but not ideal for tracking prey through the forest.

loot_defines.name: Gnome's Cloak
loot_defines.description: A simple cloak made for someone of a shorter stature, like myself.

loot_defines.name: Blending Cloak
loot_defines.description: Blends in with the forest, allowing me to pass unseen.

loot_defines.name: Long Ranger's Cloak of Vengeance
loot_defines.description: Even all these years later, my heart still beats faster when I see a dark elf.

loot_defines.name: Nearly Empty Quiver
loot_defines.description: It's still got a few bolts left; they'll have to do.

loot_defines.name: Tough Hide Quiver
loot_defines.description: It won't tear or rip when I grab a bolt.

loot_defines.name: Finely Crafted Quiver
loot_defines.description: As finely crafted a quiver as a ranger could hope for.

loot_defines.name: Bursting Quiver of the Endless Barrage
loot_defines.description: The capacity of this quiver never seems to expire.

loot_defines.name: Patchwork Glasses
loot_defines.description: Scrapped together from a few failed experiments.

loot_defines.name: Heavy Metal Glasses
loot_defines.description: They're heavy, but it's better than being blind!

loot_defines.name: Gnomish Reading Glasses
loot_defines.description: Have you read the latest symposium on clockwork animals? Fascinating!

loot_defines.name: Bifocal Glasses of the Aged Gnome
loot_defines.description: When you're as old as I am, a good set of glasses is a lifesaver.

loot_defines.name: Rusty Mechanical Squirrel
loot_defines.description: Go on, skibbers! You can make it!

loot_defines.name: Sparking Mechanical Squirrel
loot_defines.description: That... can't be good.

loot_defines.name: Skittering Mechanical Squirrel
loot_defines.description: Come on, buddy! You can make it!

loot_defines.name: Clockwork Squirrel of Alchemist's Fire
loot_defines.description: I call him skibbers! He goes boom!

loot_defines.name: Sparse Toolset
loot_defines.description: It's missing a few important tools, but I can make do.

loot_defines.name: Worn Toolset
loot_defines.description: This ol' set has gotten me out of more than a couple close scrapes.

loot_defines.name: Complete Toolset
loot_defines.description: Every tool you could ever want. No nozzle, nail, or nut can withstand me.

loot_defines.name: Tinker's Toolset of Total Annihilation
loot_defines.description: If skibbers does his job right, I'll need this set to fix him up.

loot_defines.name: Leather Bracers
loot_defines.description: I've seen house servants better equipped for battle than this.

loot_defines.name: Fashionable Gauntlets
loot_defines.description: These work with my day to night outfit... if you know what I mean.

loot_defines.name: Spiked Gauntlets
loot_defines.description: 10 points if you can poke someone in the eye. Double if you can do it without laughing.

loot_defines.name: Master Thief's Gauntlets
loot_defines.description: ... they have pockets!

loot_defines.name: Decorative Rapier
loot_defines.description: This thing couldn't cut an apple!

loot_defines.name: Esvele's Rapier
loot_defines.description: Good for my fencing lessons, but not much else.

loot_defines.name: Balanced Rapier
loot_defines.description: A good sword should be balanced and move like an extension of yourself.

loot_defines.name: The Black Viper's Rapier
loot_defines.description: I still prefer my daggers, but sometimes you need something sharp to help keep a bit of distance.

loot_defines.name: Simple Mask
loot_defines.description: I had to glue it on & awkwardly explain the red marks on my face to nobles over tea.

loot_defines.name: Thief's Mask
loot_defines.description: I once stole the wrong signet ring because I couldn't see well enough through the eye holes.

loot_defines.name: Cheeky Mask
loot_defines.description: I had to smile constantly to get the mask to stick. I hated it.

loot_defines.name: The Black Viper's Mask
loot_defines.description: Its a pity to hide a face like mine, but if I must, then I will do so in style.

loot_defines.name: Kris Dagger
loot_defines.description: One of the first items I stole. Sentimental but not too sharp.

loot_defines.name: Kara-Tur Dagger
loot_defines.description: A gift from an aunt who lives near Kara-Tur. She always gives the best gifts.

loot_defines.name: Engraved Dagger
loot_defines.description: I had them specially made in Luskan. The black horn handles fit my palms perfectly.

loot_defines.name: The Viper's Fangs
loot_defines.description: Acquired with a friend after a long adventure. They hold poison in the handle.

loot_defines.name: Ragged Cloak
loot_defines.description: Well, at least no one will recognize me in this tattered thing.

loot_defines.name: Evening Wear
loot_defines.description: I vastly prefer this to the stuffy dresses and corsets I usually have to wear.

loot_defines.name: Stealth Cloak
loot_defines.description: You won't notice me there, behind you... you'll just notice your coinpurse is gone.

loot_defines.name: Viper's Cloak
loot_defines.description: I'm known for my talents, but I'll be remembered for my fashion sense.

loot_defines.name: False Gem
loot_defines.description: The first necklace I stole. I didn't realize it was a fake.

loot_defines.name: Sparkling Necklace
loot_defines.description: It's not as nice as the ones I own, but its disappearance will still stir up some fun.

loot_defines.name: Noble Jewels
loot_defines.description: They won't miss them. Trust me.

loot_defines.name: Ostentatious Display
loot_defines.description: I hate the nobility that requires these. . . baubles to show status.

loot_defines.name: Sinister Stick
loot_defines.description: Yes, Isn't it lovely? It's meant to distract you.

loot_defines.name: Snake-Headed Staff
loot_defines.description: How folks respond to my staff tells me if I'm safe to remove my cloak.

loot_defines.name: Solemn Staff
loot_defines.description: Drop the loot, count yourself lucky, and start running.

loot_defines.name: Serpent Scepter
loot_defines.description: Don't you love how the spores worship it?

loot_defines.name: Spare Spores
loot_defines.description: You can never have enough.

loot_defines.name: Spore Shaker
loot_defines.description: In case of emergency: throw.

loot_defines.name: Spore Garden
loot_defines.description: It would be in much better shape if we stopped walking all over the Sword Coast!

loot_defines.name: Fungal Syndicate
loot_defines.description: They each have a purpose.

loot_defines.name: Creeper Bulb
loot_defines.description: I've been studying the bulb's growth. It's terrifyingly fast. I love it!

loot_defines.name: Yellow Musk Growth
loot_defines.description: This should give my garden raider quite the fright.

loot_defines.name: Yellow-Musk Zombie Rabbit
loot_defines.description: I just call it Flopsy.

loot_defines.name: Zombie Grung
loot_defines.description: I can't tell you how many times it's gotten me out of trouble! Just let 'em loose!

loot_defines.name: Snake Ring
loot_defines.description: I feel at peace whenever I can feel it on my finger.

loot_defines.name: Tail Devouring Ring
loot_defines.description: Twisting it around has become a nervous tic. I must control it.

loot_defines.name: Ouroboros
loot_defines.description: One decision walks over the last. What decision led you to me?

loot_defines.name: World Serpents
loot_defines.description: Everything is cyclical.

loot_defines.name: Sandwich Scimitar
loot_defines.description: I am civilized, much as that may surprise you.

loot_defines.name: Silent Stiletto
loot_defines.description: It's an excellent way to make my point.

loot_defines.name: Serrated Sabre
loot_defines.description: You never know what the jungles of Chult have to offer. Be prepared or be dead.

loot_defines.name: Scimitar of Dendar
loot_defines.description: The Night Serpent waits...

loot_defines.name: Sketch
loot_defines.description: You can only learn so much from bones.

loot_defines.name: Skeleton on Slate
loot_defines.description: I'm aware that it's good. But... thank you.

loot_defines.name: Spinach-Snacking Saur
loot_defines.description: The more you know of a foes habits, the easier it is to out-think them.

loot_defines.name: Stomper-Saur
loot_defines.description: This one thinks he's sneaky.

loot_defines.name: Worn Staff
loot_defines.description: It gets the job done.

loot_defines.name: Icebreaker Staff
loot_defines.description: Here, hold my staff. Let me juggle for you!

loot_defines.name: Backup Staff
loot_defines.description: For when we really need to hit the harmonies!

loot_defines.name: Songstress Staff
loot_defines.description: You'll regret the day the Sirens turned their eyes on you.

loot_defines.name: Castoff Camouflage
loot_defines.description: The less familiar I am, today, the better.

loot_defines.name: Borrowed Cloak
loot_defines.description: Come on, we need to fit in here!

loot_defines.name: Cloak of Many Fashions
loot_defines.description: Looking good is its own revenge.

loot_defines.name: Deva's Regalia
loot_defines.description: Wait, did it happen again?

loot_defines.name: Morning Robe
loot_defines.description: Oh this? It's my workout gear.

loot_defines.name: Evening Shawl
loot_defines.description: Come watch the sunset with me.

loot_defines.name: Robe of Resilience
loot_defines.description: Vlahnya has another heist for us. Best look my best.

loot_defines.name: Dazzling Armor of the Diva
loot_defines.description: Watch me roll.

loot_defines.name: Road Gear
loot_defines.description: I'm with the band.

loot_defines.name: Charming Shield
loot_defines.description: Let me sing you a song...

loot_defines.name: Ancient Armor
loot_defines.description: We recovered it when we were repairing the Yawning Portal. Don't tell Durnan.

loot_defines.name: Radiant Shield
loot_defines.description: You mess with one of our bandmates, you mess with all of us.

loot_defines.name: Costume Jewelry
loot_defines.description: I'd rather go without.

loot_defines.name: Child's Creation
loot_defines.description: My dad said that it makes me invincible. Why tempt fate?

loot_defines.name: Concert Wear
loot_defines.description: Gotta look my best for our show!

loot_defines.name: Diva Crown
loot_defines.description: I'll distract them, you grab the mark!

loot_defines.name: Weathered Sheet
loot_defines.description: Let's do this, Sirens!

loot_defines.name: Missed Show Flier
loot_defines.description: Ghost was a cat at the time..?

loot_defines.name: Performance Review
loot_defines.description: They loved the show, just not the fight that broke out after.

loot_defines.name: Yawning Portal Presents
loot_defines.description: All proceeds go to Durnan to pay for portal repair.

loot_defines.name: Heroic Blade
loot_defines.description: You don't need anything fancy.

loot_defines.name: Sword of Promise
loot_defines.description: My father saw a lot of promise in me, but it's not the right sort of promise.

loot_defines.name: Possessed Sword
loot_defines.description: When we found Voronika, I had to save her -- by imbuing my sword with her ghost.

loot_defines.name: Edge of Sorrow
loot_defines.description: What the Mists have taken from me, I will repay them in turn.

loot_defines.name: Practice Weapon
loot_defines.description: I spent long hours learning to fight.

loot_defines.name: Training Blade
loot_defines.description: Fighting came naturally to me--more naturally than politics.

loot_defines.name: Hunter's Blade
loot_defines.description: You get the sword. I'll save my claws for a real threat.

loot_defines.name: Sword of Koshmarr
loot_defines.description: This isn't my destiny, is it?

loot_defines.name: Distance Weapon
loot_defines.description: Sometimes it's best to strike from a distance.

loot_defines.name: Ranger's Crossbow
loot_defines.description: Depending on the prey, I'd rather have my space.

loot_defines.name: Crossbow of the Hunter
loot_defines.description: My aim is flawless.

loot_defines.name: Shadowfell Repeater
loot_defines.description: When clawed things come out of the sky, it's better to shoot first and fast.

loot_defines.name: Haunting Jewelry
loot_defines.description: This was a gift from my father.

loot_defines.name: Family Keepsake
loot_defines.description: Feels ominous, getting this as a boy, then being bitten by a werewolf.

loot_defines.name: Wolf's Tooth Necklace
loot_defines.description: It's my touchstone. Reminds me who I am and what I came from.

loot_defines.name: Noble Promise
loot_defines.description: The wolf is in me, and so is Koshmarr.

loot_defines.name: Roughmade Armor
loot_defines.description: You want a piece of me?

loot_defines.name: Battered Protection
loot_defines.description: I don't need this, but I can fight longer with it.

loot_defines.name: Pauldrons of Shadow
loot_defines.description: The deeper we travel, the heavier my armor grows.

loot_defines.name: Pack Lord's Armor
loot_defines.description: If no one else will stand against this evil, I will.

loot_defines.name: Useful Bag
loot_defines.description: You never know what you'll need in the Mists.

loot_defines.name: Sack for Gear
loot_defines.description: I'm ready for anything.

loot_defines.name: Storage Pouch
loot_defines.description: Big enough a large flask in case someone starts talking politics.

loot_defines.name: Embroidered Satchel
loot_defines.description: I've picked up a few surprises.

loot_defines.name: Practice Blade
loot_defines.description: I've trained with this so long, my grip's worn the hilt.

loot_defines.name: Sturdy Sword
loot_defines.description: Keep the edge keen and well-oiled.

loot_defines.name: Tempest's Talon
loot_defines.description: This sword was a gift from a dragon.

loot_defines.name: Blade of the Storm
loot_defines.description: Our power suffuses it.

loot_defines.name: Standard Boots
loot_defines.description: They do the job.

loot_defines.name: Uniform Shoes
loot_defines.description: Every part of this outfit is standard issue.

loot_defines.name: Stealthy Kicks
loot_defines.description: Boots are a great place to hide extra blades.

loot_defines.name: Dragonrider's Sabatons
loot_defines.description: Better protection when you're up in the air.

loot_defines.name: Beginner's Longbow
loot_defines.description: I'm an excellent shot.

loot_defines.name: Hunter's Bow
loot_defines.description: Hunting with a bow requires patience.

loot_defines.name: Handmade Hunter
loot_defines.description: I made this bow myself, carved every sigil into the wood.

loot_defines.name: Enchanted Longbow
loot_defines.description: With this, I cannot miss.

loot_defines.name: Training Armor
loot_defines.description: I remember every scar on this armor.

loot_defines.name: Protective Tunic
loot_defines.description: You have to learn to take a hit as well as make a strike.

loot_defines.name: Armored Uniform
loot_defines.description: The war rages on, and I must do my part.

loot_defines.name: Drakewarden's Armor
loot_defines.description: This armor befits Tempest's rider.

loot_defines.name: Dragon Scales
loot_defines.description: These are from Tempest, the dragon I bonded with.

loot_defines.name: Shed Skin
loot_defines.description: A kalashtar is bonded to a spirit of the dream. I've expanded that to Tempest.

loot_defines.name: Drake's Tooth
loot_defines.description: Tempest is a fierce fighter, but a kind friend.

loot_defines.name: Soul of the Tempest
loot_defines.description: When I found Tempest trapped in that canyon, I had no idea what I was beginning.

loot_defines.name: Memory of Tristan
loot_defines.description: Tristan was like my sister. We've been through so much together.

loot_defines.name: Best Friend's Bracelet
loot_defines.description: We grew up together. We trained in the miltary together.

loot_defines.name: Hunting Dagger
loot_defines.description: Tristan always looked out for me when I couldn't look out for myself.

loot_defines.name: Signet Ring
loot_defines.description: The gem looks like a dragon eye. It reminds me of the two dearest people in my life.

loot_defines.name: Childhood Training
loot_defines.description: I was the scourge of small creatures all across Rashemen.

loot_defines.name: Old Slingshot
loot_defines.description: Not much in a real fight.

loot_defines.name: Adventurer's Sling
loot_defines.description: Spells aren't always the answer.

loot_defines.name: Enchanted Sling
loot_defines.description: I've yet to find a creature this cannot harm!

loot_defines.name: First Attempt
loot_defines.description: I carved this as a child. I pretended I was a Wychlaran.

loot_defines.name: Witch-Mask
loot_defines.description: Masks have power in ways many don't seem to know...

loot_defines.name: Rashemi Face-Veil
loot_defines.description: I remember the first time I wore this. All of my life had led to that.

loot_defines.name: Regal Asatheirr
loot_defines.description: All Wychlaran, past and present, are with me now.

loot_defines.name: Important Lead

loot_defines.name: Robe Fragment
loot_defines.description: They were here - and not long ago. We must be quick.

loot_defines.name: Forged Thayan Missive
loot_defines.description: Finally, we can strike them where it hurts

loot_defines.name: Red Wizard Trophy
loot_defines.description: I carry this in remembrance of all the lives it took.

loot_defines.name: A Reminder of Home
loot_defines.description: Somehow, these still smell of Rashemen.

loot_defines.name: Rashemi Attire
loot_defines.description: Part of me misses wearing this. But I've moved on to greater robes.

loot_defines.name: Wychlaran Garments
loot_defines.description: This gives me the commanding presence I demand.

loot_defines.name: Robes of the Archmage
loot_defines.description: Can we do something about the red? I don't like red robes.

loot_defines.name: It Will Do
loot_defines.description: We have to eat, right?

loot_defines.description: You worry about the frontline. I'll handle the ones in the back!

loot_defines.name: Wychlaran Component Pouch

loot_defines.name: Dull Naginata
loot_defines.description: Still functions as a passable stave. I will need to get this sharpened.

loot_defines.name: Steel Naginata
loot_defines.description: A decent enough material, for your type at least.

loot_defines.name: Silver Naginata
loot_defines.description: Aha! Gith silver is unparallelled in battle. For Zaerith!

loot_defines.name: Kensei Naginata of Illithid Slaying
loot_defines.description: The force of this Naginata disrupts the Illithid's psionic field.

loot_defines.name: Woven Bracers
loot_defines.description: They are quite comfortable, unlike your Material Plane.

loot_defines.name: Dyed Wool Bracers
loot_defines.description: Your world is cold and unpleasant, but I will adapt.

loot_defines.name: Fine Bracers
loot_defines.description: I would prefer a Limbo-crafted pair, but these will do.

loot_defines.name: Chaotic Bracers of the Githzerai
loot_defines.description: Crafted by Githzerai artificers out of Limbo chaos-stuff.

loot_defines.name: Sealed Jug
loot_defines.description: Well that's not much use to me now, is it?

loot_defines.name: Empty Jug
loot_defines.description: Almost as useless as a sealed jug, but at least I can fill it.

loot_defines.name: Alchemy Jug
loot_defines.description: A wonderous device. Would you like 2 gallons of mayonnaise?

loot_defines.name: Overflowing Alchemy Jug
loot_defines.description: Useful for long journeys through the Material Plane, such as the one I'm on.

loot_defines.name: Ruby Amulet
loot_defines.description: A trinket. A toy. Not of much use, to be honest.

loot_defines.name: Bloodstone Amulet
loot_defines.description: A precious gem for you, perhaps, but easily come by in Limbo.

loot_defines.name: Calming Amulet
loot_defines.description: Only when one is calm can one access Ki.

loot_defines.name: Planar Amulet of Homecoming
loot_defines.description: The swirling reminds me of Limbo.

loot_defines.name: Short Scarf
loot_defines.description: A simple accessory, but comforting in this strange place.

loot_defines.name: Heavy Scarf
loot_defines.description: Keeps me warm during cold Material Plane nights.

loot_defines.name: Embroidered Scarf
loot_defines.description: Flits and flutters behind me in battle.

loot_defines.name: Scarf of Fluid Motion
loot_defines.description: When my Ki is centered, the scarf barely flutters at all.

loot_defines.name: Depleted Ioun Stone
loot_defines.description: Perhaps it once held some small magic.

loot_defines.name: Dim Ioun Stone
loot_defines.description: Its magic barely strong enough to detect, let alone make use of.

loot_defines.name: Ioun Stone of Awareness
loot_defines.description: I can't be surprised when this stone's magic is active.

loot_defines.name: Pulsing Ioun Stone of Wisdom
loot_defines.description: Wisdom isn't something the Githzerai lack, but this takes it to a new level.

loot_defines.name: Symbol of the Phoenix
loot_defines.description: In a way... you've actually got the Phoenix here helping.

loot_defines.name: Phoenix Writings
loot_defines.description: The Phoenix is going to be SO excited to hear about this!!!

loot_defines.name: The Domain of the Phoenix
loot_defines.description: The Phoenix represents creation, destruction, resurrection, and renewal.

loot_defines.name: Opulent Holy Symbol
loot_defines.description: The Phoenix is wonderful! They're warm, welcoming...and they always listen!

loot_defines.name: Well-Worn Pants
loot_defines.description: Hi. Did you have any questions? I get this a lot.

loot_defines.name: Pants That Fit!
loot_defines.description: It's real hard to find clothing that fits, I gotta make what I have last!

loot_defines.name: Orkira's Makeshift Pants
loot_defines.description: I got custom-tailored clothing in Waterdeep! They even fit around the tail!

loot_defines.name: Pantaloons of the Dragonborn
loot_defines.description: Yeah. I'm used to being weird everywhere.

loot_defines.name: Cooking for Friends
loot_defines.description: When you find... people, friends... family, It's easy to feel welcome finally.

loot_defines.name: Tasty Burn Paste
loot_defines.description: Got some burns? I've got the antidote.

loot_defines.name: Marshmallow Paste
loot_defines.description: It's REALLY fluffy.

loot_defines.name: Homemade Treats
loot_defines.description: I made some for everyone!

loot_defines.name: Pillow Rocks
loot_defines.description: Who me? I can sleep anywhere. Can you pass the scratchy rock?

loot_defines.name: Decision Pebbles
loot_defines.description: One problem at a time.

loot_defines.name: Letters from Alyndra
loot_defines.description: We're going to get coffee and truffles soon.

loot_defines.name: Harold's Accordion
loot_defines.description: I'd do anything to protect him! I feel bad about the accordion though...

loot_defines.name: Undead Basher
loot_defines.description: Tell Avren I do NOT need one of his creepy bags, this'll work just fine!

loot_defines.name: Traveler's Sac
loot_defines.description: Do you not have dragonborn in this plane of existence?

loot_defines.name: Orkira's Jump Bag
loot_defines.description: My whole life is in this bag. I'm always ready to go!

loot_defines.name: Resurrection Components
loot_defines.description: I need to save a little bit, in case one of you dies...

loot_defines.name: Phoenix Drawing
loot_defines.description: I hate being cold. Even the reminder of warmth helps!

loot_defines.name: Penelope's Feather Art
loot_defines.description: Wow! I really like... all the... flames. Can I keep this?

loot_defines.name: Ashes of the Phoenix
loot_defines.description: It's my job to keep others from getting burned.

loot_defines.name: Phoenix Feather
loot_defines.description: Doesn't it just... So pretty...

loot_defines.name: Fond Memories
loot_defines.description: Even at my lowest, playing with Tara lifted my spirits...

loot_defines.name: Ball of Retrieval
loot_defines.description: ...though the ball's purpose eluded her. I was always the one fetching it...

loot_defines.name: Cat Flap of Displacement
loot_defines.description: Tara comes and goes as she pleases. But she's always pleased to help me.

loot_defines.name: Ring of Evasion
loot_defines.description: A ring as evasive as Tara, when I asked how she obtained it...

loot_defines.name: These Old Things
loot_defines.description: Comfortable, practical, and relatively unsinged.

loot_defines.name: Wizarding Robes
loot_defines.description: Not as flashy as Elminster's, but at least they've plenty of pockets.

loot_defines.name: Robes of Increased Potency
loot_defines.description: I could get used to these. Elegant, but powerful - just like Tara.

loot_defines.name: Archmage's Accoutrements
loot_defines.description: Incredible! Every stitch is infused with Weave. Like wearing magic itself...

loot_defines.name: Nothing Much
loot_defines.description: I'd have preferred something with a library...

loot_defines.name: Camping Tent
loot_defines.description: ...but it will do. For now.

loot_defines.name: Crystal Ball
loot_defines.description: Handy for glimpsing the future. And also shaving.

loot_defines.name: Celestial Spyglass
loot_defines.description: I like gazing at the heavens. To remember. And to forget...

loot_defines.name: Crumpled Chapbooks
loot_defines.description: At least they're written in full sentences.

loot_defines.name: Well-thumbed Tomes
loot_defines.description: I've lost count of how many times I've read these. Still just as magical.

loot_defines.name: Magical Miscellany
loot_defines.description: A spell for all situations. And my improvements in the margins.

loot_defines.name: The Annals of Karsus
loot_defines.description: You can trust me with this - you have my word.

loot_defines.name: Boots of Ambiguous Enchantment
loot_defines.description: A little pick-me-up, for when any Weave will do...

loot_defines.name: Lonely Boot of Elvenkind
loot_defines.description: A snack-sized shoe for the wizard who travels light.

loot_defines.name: Boots of Very Fast Blinking
loot_defines.description: Blink and you'll miss me. But I'll always hit you.

loot_defines.name: Mystra's Grace
loot_defines.description: These were a gift from... well, never mind.

loot_defines.name: Cramped Jotter
loot_defines.description: Magical musings and mullings. Not my best handwriting.

loot_defines.name: Waterdhavian Quill
loot_defines.description: This was... well, it was expensive, let's leave it at that.

loot_defines.name: The Chosen's Earring
loot_defines.description: A symbol of Mystra's faith in me. Former faith, I suppose...

loot_defines.name: Wizard's Pouch
loot_defines.description: All manner of wizarding sundries. Pungent but powerful.

loot_defines.name: Volo's Crumpled Cap
loot_defines.description: Drat. Another one. You would not believe how many of these I go through.

loot_defines.name: Volo's Basic Beret
loot_defines.description: Not a snug fit, but it will do for some comfort during my daily ruminations.

loot_defines.name: Volo's Handsome Headpiece
loot_defines.description: Aha! An acceptable adornment. It does lend an air of refinement, doesn't it?

loot_defines.name: Volo's Magnificent Millinery
loot_defines.description: Finally! A crown fit for my brow. A reflection of my very soul, no doubt!

loot_defines.name: Volo's Discarded Dagger
loot_defines.description: That dull, old thing? Why, I hardly recognize it. Perhaps it may open letters?

loot_defines.name: Volo's Curvaceous Cutter
loot_defines.description: An elegant edge, to be sure. One I hope to never find cause to use!

loot_defines.name: Volo's Resplendent Rapier
loot_defines.description: More for show than anything, but it does help to keep the ruffians at bay.

loot_defines.name: Volo's Quintessential Quill
loot_defines.description: Scoff if you must, but I dare say I hold in my hand the mightiest of blades!

loot_defines.name: Volo's Counterfeit Canvas
loot_defines.description: A far cry from the genuine article, but he is a handsome devil, is he not?

loot_defines.name: Volo's Perfect Portraiture
loot_defines.description: Once stolen, but later returned. There is, perhaps, some honor among thieves.

loot_defines.name: Volo's Daring Deed
loot_defines.description: Shall I tell you of a remarkable and historic property in Waterdeep?

loot_defines.name: Volo's Ersatz Eye
loot_defines.description: Take this. A far superior relic than that old jelly you were chained to.

loot_defines.name: Volo's Discontinued Draft
loot_defines.description: Was this a treatise on goblin poetry, a recipe book, or a sordid romance novel?

loot_defines.name: Volo's Waterdeep Enchiridion
loot_defines.description: You have in your hands the foremost and most up-to-date guide to the city.

loot_defines.name: Volo's Multitudinous Manuals
loot_defines.description: No matter your destination, Volothamp Geddarm shall be your humble guide!

loot_defines.name: Volo's Guide to Monsters
loot_defines.description: Would you believe a particularly artistic hydra created this incredible cover?

loot_defines.name: Volo's Rejected Report

loot_defines.description: Eric says he found these in the jungle. They're kind of cute!

loot_defines.description: Bobby! You forgot to open Hank and Uni's presents!

loot_defines.name: A Friendly Surprise
loot_defines.description: Thanks, guys. I haven't seen Bobby that happy in a long time.

loot_defines.name: Patchy Rags
loot_defines.description: Oh no, not another tear!

loot_defines.name: Mended Mantle
loot_defines.description: I'll be more careful with this one.

loot_defines.description: When I put on the hood, I vanish! Watch!

loot_defines.name: Cloak of Perfect Concealment
loot_defines.description: I'll be like a ghost. Venger will never find me now.

loot_defines.name: Poorly Made Boots
loot_defines.description: These old things are ready to fall apart.

loot_defines.name: Just Right Boots
loot_defines.description: That's much better! No more tripping!

loot_defines.name: Adventuring Boots
loot_defines.description: These boots were made for adventuring, and that's just what I'll do!

loot_defines.name: Boots of Silent Passage
loot_defines.description: I'll be as quiet as a mouse, and ten times more dangerous.

loot_defines.name: Sad Little Sash
loot_defines.description: It lost its color weeks ago.

loot_defines.name: Functional Sash
loot_defines.description: As long as it works, I won't complain.

loot_defines.name: Bright Belt
loot_defines.description: Who knew green and purple could go so well together?

loot_defines.name: Waistguard of Grace
loot_defines.description: I feel so light with this on, like I could even dance on the clouds!

loot_defines.name: Danger Pin
loot_defines.description: Ouch! It keeps poking me!

loot_defines.name: Safety Pin
loot_defines.description: One of these can help keep anything in place.

loot_defines.name: Stylish Clasp
loot_defines.description: This keeps my cloak from falling off no matter what dangers we face.

loot_defines.name: Clasp of Protection
loot_defines.description: The less I have to worry about myself, the more I can focus on Bobby.

loot_defines.name: Cracked Gem
loot_defines.description: It's what my parents gave the monks who took me in. It was all they had.

loot_defines.name: Bloodstone
loot_defines.description: I've restored it as best I could. It's not worth much, but it's precious to me.

loot_defines.description: Where I'm from the wilderness is dark, cold, and full of terror.

loot_defines.name: Ironfell Memento
loot_defines.description: My parents sacrificed everything for me. I will make the best of this life.

loot_defines.name: Etched Bangle
loot_defines.description: The inscription is my name. It means 'flawless' in elvish. No, I'm not vain!

loot_defines.name: Polished Bangle
loot_defines.description: I wear it to remind myself that nothing is perfect, and that's okay.

loot_defines.name: Elegant Hairpin
loot_defines.description: This world has plenty of flaws, and so what? It's still worth fighting for.

loot_defines.name: Exquisite Hand Chain
loot_defines.description: Real beauty comes from within, and shows your true face to the world.

loot_defines.name: Prayer Beads
loot_defines.description: They're not magical, but they look nice, right?

loot_defines.name: Sunite Beads
loot_defines.description: Lady Firehair teaches us to love ourselves, each other, and all things.

loot_defines.name: Ruby Rose Broach
loot_defines.description: For special occasions, like a wedding. That's always a day worth waiting for.

loot_defines.name: Arborean Shawl
loot_defines.description: My ultimate accessory for self-expression, however I feel each day!

loot_defines.description: These were so bad that I started to make my own clothing.

loot_defines.name: Portrait of Isolde
loot_defines.description: Everything I've done has been for her.

loot_defines.name: Shared Tattoo
loot_defines.description: This art signifies our love more than a ring ever could.

loot_defines.name: Tattered Jacket
loot_defines.description: I've had this since I lived down in the Underdark.

loot_defines.name: Refurbished Coat
loot_defines.description: I tore off all the badges I didn't agree with.

loot_defines.name: Traveller's Trenchcoat
loot_defines.description: Everyone needs a sturdy coat that repels mist.

loot_defines.name: Feywild Duster
loot_defines.description: Style, substance, and plenty of pockets.

loot_defines.name: Battered Boots
loot_defines.description: They may be worn, but they'll still kick a hole in a zombie.

loot_defines.name: Boots of Wandering
loot_defines.description: I've traveled all through the mists in these.

loot_defines.name: Brawler's Bracers
loot_defines.description: Go ahead. Let's see what you're made of.

loot_defines.name: Armored Layer
loot_defines.description: You never know when you need to be ready for a fight.

loot_defines.name: Makeshift Lockpicks
loot_defines.description: When you can't afford to just bash through the door.

loot_defines.name: Practice Bondbreaker
loot_defines.description: I've been at this a while.

loot_defines.name: Thief's Tools
loot_defines.description: Deep breath, steady hands.

loot_defines.name: Dire Devices
loot_defines.description: You don't need to know what these are for.

loot_defines.name: Sharp Edge
loot_defines.description: The Underdark is full of monsters. I learned the sword early.

loot_defines.name: Adventurer's Blade
loot_defines.description: The Mists are full of surprises, many of them stabbable.

loot_defines.name: Longsword of Vengeance
loot_defines.description: Vengeance cuts both ways...but mostly toward my enemies.

loot_defines.name: Nepenthe
loot_defines.description: I had a score to settle with the Caller. Bearing Nepenthe is worth it.

loot_defines.name: Dried Meat
loot_defines.description: Bringing your own provisions into the mists is a good choice.

loot_defines.name: Beef Jerky
loot_defines.description: I'm absolutely certain THIS ONE is beef.

loot_defines.name: Goblet of Blood
loot_defines.description: I'm parched.

loot_defines.name: Feywild Candy
loot_defines.description: Tasty, but tricky.

loot_defines.name: After Battle Plans
loot_defines.description: Gods, it'll be good to have a cold drink again.

loot_defines.name: Party Supplies
loot_defines.description: You're having fun, aren't you?

loot_defines.name: Silver Spoon
loot_defines.description: Killed a Barlgura with one of these. Good for eye-scooping.

loot_defines.name: Clive, the Teddy Bear
loot_defines.description: Clivey baby boo boo boy I love you.

loot_defines.name: New Look
loot_defines.description: These'll help me blend in with the hordes.

loot_defines.name: Heat Resistant Pants
loot_defines.description: Fit for the temperaturally challenged.

loot_defines.name: Avernus Leathers
loot_defines.description: You don't want to know who I peeled this leather from. Trust me.

loot_defines.name: Helldusk Armour
loot_defines.description: I CAN FLY NOW?!

loot_defines.name: Starting Somewhere
loot_defines.description: Baby's first chopper.

loot_defines.name: Hand Axe
loot_defines.description: What it lacks in size, it makes up for by being better than nothing.

loot_defines.name: Masterwork Greataxe
loot_defines.description: Now that's what I call a greataxe! Let's let some blood.

loot_defines.name: Zariel's Gift
loot_defines.description: One devil's gift is another Karlach's curse.

loot_defines.name: Engine Conversion Plans
loot_defines.description: Zariel said she killed the smith who made these. Always was paranoid.

loot_defines.name: Infernal Iron
loot_defines.description: I know what to do with this! Or Dammon does, anyway.

loot_defines.name: Heart of Iron
loot_defines.description: Look at that. It's almost beautiful.

loot_defines.name: First Ink
loot_defines.description: When in Avernus...

loot_defines.name: 'Zariel'
loot_defines.description: The more I look at those six letters, the less they scare me.

loot_defines.name: 'Elitesquad'
loot_defines.description: I'm elite and I was in a squad, what's confusing about that?

loot_defines.name: 'Demonsbane'
loot_defines.description: Has a ring to it, doesn't it? Though I much prefer 'Cliffgate' myself.

loot_defines.name: Fuel Source
loot_defines.description: Hmm. If we find one with a bit more juice, we can rev things up.

loot_defines.name: Partially Spent Soul Coin
loot_defines.description: It's something, soldier, but this won't cut it.

loot_defines.name: Soul Coin
loot_defines.description: Let's kick things up a notch.

loot_defines.name: Stockpile
loot_defines.description: Should I use all of these at once? No. Right? No. Maybe...

loot_defines.name: Rough Hewn Chatkcha
loot_defines.description: Suitable for practice, not for a true challenge.

loot_defines.name: Pitchstone Chatkcha
loot_defines.description: Obsidian of low quality is acceptable for a hunt of the same.

loot_defines.name: Hamaad Chatkcha
loot_defines.description: A Calishite fool once hunted me for revenge. I made this from her steel.

loot_defines.name: Ka'eth'rek
loot_defines.description: This word means Blade Eye. It is a reminder to always look sharp.

loot_defines.name: Paper Flower
loot_defines.description: Childish ephemera, but this shape is pleasing to me.

loot_defines.name: Alluring Bloom
loot_defines.description: I found this on the first day of my exile. It sings so sweetly in my mind.

loot_defines.name: Ancient Symbol
loot_defines.description: The mark of the Celestial Lotus. I will know its words. I will sing its song.

loot_defines.name: Lyric of the Eternal Lotus
loot_defines.description: I am its keeper. I am worthy. It will find another when I am gone.

loot_defines.name: Drab Mineral
loot_defines.description: There is no power here, but that too is worth knowing.

loot_defines.name: Worked Quartz
loot_defines.description: Simple crystal stimulates curiosity. This is useful for new journeys.

loot_defines.name: Precious Gemstones
loot_defines.description: Ruby for skill, fortune, vengeance. Sapphire for the mind, magic, and mourning.

loot_defines.name: Psionic Foci
loot_defines.description: Amethyst for logic. Rainbow obsidian for power. For intention. For the kill.

loot_defines.name: Empty Flask
loot_defines.description: It is an insult to be given this. It means leave and never return.

loot_defines.name: Filled Canteen
loot_defines.description: Water is life. All who wander the Shaar know this.

loot_defines.name: Gourmet Rations
loot_defines.description: The flesh of the dire horse is a delicacy among my kind. You must try it. Now.

loot_defines.name: Nomad's Pride
loot_defines.description: I made this. I charted the Shaar. Every shadow, every step. I know this land.

loot_defines.name: Old Prey
loot_defines.description: I do not remember this kill. Perhaps another will refresh my memory.

loot_defines.name: Fresh Quarry
loot_defines.description: Do not mindlink with me until I've had my morning hunt.

loot_defines.name: Grim Trophies
loot_defines.description: They thought they were safe. There is no such thing.

loot_defines.name: Exotic Remnants
loot_defines.description: They were beautiful to behold. Magnificent. I brought them a suitable end.

loot_defines.name: Crude Stone Gythka
loot_defines.description: The young train with these. My first weapon, for my first hunt.

loot_defines.name: Pitchstone Gythka
loot_defines.description: To hold the gythka is an honor. To learn it, a promise. To master it, a life.

loot_defines.name: Solbar Gythka
loot_defines.description: To hunt a sultan of Calimshan, this was my payment, and his demise.

loot_defines.name: Drak'en'raa
loot_defines.description: This word means Pathless. It hurt me once. Now it is mine to wield.

augment_defines.title: Golden Offers
augment_defines.description: One of your weekly offers will be Golden during this event. Golden offers provide an additional 10% discount! The Golden tag persists when an offer is rerolled.

augment_defines.title: Auto-Blacksmith
augment_defines.description:
Event Champions whose recruitment adventure or variants you complete gain common rarity equipment in all slots, if they don't already have better.
Every tier two or higher event variant completed automatically applies 100 Tiny Blacksmithing Contracts to the variant's Champion's equipment for free!

augment_defines.title: Challenge Week
augment_defines.description: A Mastery Challenge will start on the third week of the event, providing opportunities to prove your formation building skills and earn unique rewards.

augment_defines.title: Boon Enhancements
augment_defines.description: An additional boon buff at each level increases global damage based on the number of Dragonborn, Kobold, melee base attack, or Heroes of the Lance Champions in your formation, stacking additively.

augment_defines.title: Boon XP
augment_defines.description: The Boon system has been reworked in this event! Eligible items purchased with Platinum now grant Boon XP, which unlocks Boon Levels. The Boon Level cap has also been removed.

augment_defines.title: Extra Benefits
augment_defines.description: When the event ends, you'll earn Scales of Tiamat based on what you completed within the event. You'll get 250 Scales for every event variant of tier 2 or above that you have completed, and 250 Scales for each Boon XP you've obtained. Scales of Tiamat are used in the Legendary Forge to craft Legendary Equipment.

augment_defines.title: Worth the Wait (Generic)
augment_defines.description: The rebalanced Champion releases at the start of week two of this event.
